note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes SharePointTenantSettings.ReadWrite.All, Reports.Read.All, ReportSettings.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Sites.ReadWrite.All, Files.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# remember the real values: teardown puts isResharingByExternalUsersEnabled back

Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/admin/sharepoint/settings -OutputType PSObject | Select-Object sharingCapability, isResharingByExternalUsersEnabled, isRequireAcceptingUserToMatchInvitedUserEnabled, isLegacyAuthProtocolsEnabled, sharingDomainRestrictionMode, isSitesStorageLimitAutomatic | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep11-settings.json')

function New-LabSite($name, $nick) { $g = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$name'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $g) { $g = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = $name; mailNickname = $nick; mailEnabled = $true; securityEnabled = $false; groupTypes = @('Unified'); 'owners@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/me).id)") } }; $d = $null; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30 -and -not $d; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; try { $d = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)/sites/root/drive" } catch {} }; [pscustomobject]@{ Group = $g; Drive = $d } }
# MG Lab Finance: three files so it has activity; MG Lab Archive: one file, then leave it alone for at least inactiveDays; MG Lab Empty: nothing
$fin = New-LabSite 'MG Lab Finance' 'mglab-finance-site'; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { Add-LabFile $fin.Drive "Budget $_.txt" 'Contoso lab file' }
$arc = New-LabSite 'MG Lab Archive' 'mglab-archive-site'; Add-LabFile $arc.Drive 'Old plan.txt' 'Contoso lab file'

$c = Get-Content ./src/sharepoint-baseline.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $c.sites.inactiveDays = 3; $c.remediate.allowedSettings = @('isResharingByExternalUsersEnabled'); $c | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/sharepoint-baseline.lab.json   # the lab is days old; production default is 90
(Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/admin/reportSettings).displayConcealedNames   # must be True: it is the first beat of the audit screen
./src/Invoke-SharePointAdmin.ps1 -BaselineFile ./src/sharepoint-baseline.lab.json   # off-camera dry run; add system sites to sites.ignoreSiteUrlPatterns if any show up

screens.name: sharing-policy
steps: Policies > Sharing: show the External sharing level for SharePoint
Tick 'Allow guests to share items they don't own'
Save (this is the real drift the audit finds)
mask: tenant name in the top bar and in the admin URL

screens.name: audit
commands: # clear 'Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports' (admin center > Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports); same setting through Graph:

steps: Reload SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing > More external sharing settings: 'Allow guests to share items they don't own' is cleared
If it still shows ticked, wait, reload and say so on camera
mask: tenant name in the top bar and admin URL

steps: Reload Policies > Sharing > More external sharing settings: the box is ticked again
Then untick it by hand so the lab ends clean (if the restore said Skipped, read the message on camera: someone changed the value after us)
mask: tenant name in the top bar and admin URL

teardown: Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method PATCH -Uri /v1.0/admin/reportSettings -Body @{ displayConcealedNames = $true }   # the privacy default again

foreach ($nm in 'MG Lab Finance', 'MG Lab Archive', 'MG Lab Empty') { foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$nm'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)" } }

Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/directory/deletedItems/microsoft.graph.group?`$filter=startswith(displayName,'MG Lab ')").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/directory/deletedItems/$($g.id)" }
# by hand: SharePoint admin center > Sites > Deleted sites: delete the three MG Lab sites permanently
needs: wait:at least 3 days after prepare (usage report data and an inactive MG Lab Archive); the Reports concealment is cleared during the audit screen and set back in teardown
